claims.value: Lantern Slide (black and white) of a sliced image in three; view of the quarry of Rano Raraku; a fallen moai (figure carving) is lying on its face in the centre of the image, with a man and a horse standing beside it; Easter Island.

notes.text: This British Museum catalogue record describes a lantern slide attributed to Katherine Maria Routledge, photographed in 1914–1915. It is registered as a documentary source, not as a physical Rapa Nui artefact, and no image is published. The catalogue's complete Description identifies the quarry as Rano Raraku and describes the view; the longer curator's overview is not extracted.
